documents.title: PostgreSQL advisory locks
documents.text: DocsMint uses PostgreSQL advisory locks to serialize re-embed jobs per document. A leaked lock blocked the worker until pg_terminate_backend released it.

documents.title: Reciprocal rank fusion
documents.text: Search fuses exact, FTS, fuzzy, vector, expanded, and graph channels with reciprocal rank fusion. RRF_K defaults to 60.

documents.title: GraphRAG with Apache AGE
documents.text: Entity extraction writes Person Organization Concept Location Topic nodes into Apache AGE. Graph neighbors expand search beyond lexical matches.

documents.title: 1024-dimensional embeddings
documents.text: Every embedding provider must return a finite non-zero 1024-dimensional vector. Voyage-4-lite and bge-m3 are native 1024 models.

documents.title: Public share links
documents.text: Standalone share creates a public token link. Guest access never includes owner_id in the URL.

documents.title: SeaweedFS attachments
documents.text: Images are stored in SeaweedFS S3. Presigned PUT URLs expire after fifteen minutes.

documents.title: Better Auth sessions
documents.text: Protected routes require a Better Auth session cookie. Admin operator tools use HIAI_DOCS_API_KEY.

documents.title: Sourdough starter notes
documents.text: Feed the starter twice a day. This cooking note is an irrelevant distractor for retrieval tests.
